input.prompt: Which payment rails and protocols are emerging for AI agents?

message.content:
Emerging payment rails for AI agents include traditional financial networks and novel blockchain-based systems.

Traditional rails leverage existing infrastructure for reliability and regulatory clarity, but can be slower and have higher transaction fees, suiting larger, less frequent payments. Blockchain systems offer faster, lower-cost, peer-to-peer transactions, ideal for micropayments and real-time settlements, but may have higher volatility and regulatory uncertainty.

replies.answer: The answer compares the two kinds of rail in general terms; it gives no figures for speed or cost.
